# Distribution output

Run `./tools/package.sh` from the repository root to create the physical-device
release archive `Cyan-0.1.0-h1x0.zip` here. Generated ZIP files are not tracked.

Run `./tools/package-distribution.sh` to create the documented release-candidate
bundle `Cyan-0.1.0-h1x0-distribution.zip`, which contains the clean install ZIP,
license, checksums, installation/compatibility/release notes, final-validation
and physical-test procedures, and labeled browser-proxy screenshots.
